verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only importing into the Consensus Library (from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS). The REST API and MCP server expose paper search and synthesis, not export of a user's own library, threads, or account data. Import formats and a search API are adjacent features and do not show that a user can export all their data in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
